sections.label: YOU KNOW
items: The other Centrists: you open your eyes together at setup.

sections.label: GOOD TO KNOW
items: If you are radicalised, you join the Communists. The other Centrists are not told and may still trust you.

sections.label: TIPS
items: Wait before you reveal that you are Centrists.
Fascists will pretend to be Centrists.
The Communists will want to radicalise you.

rulebook.title: Centrists
rulebook.addWhen: the game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.addWhenTable: The game is big and the Liberals need a small group that trusts each other.
rulebook.pitch: Liberals who know each other from the start: a trusted core the others can build on.

details.label: Goal
text: You play for the Liberal team. You win when the Liberal board is full or when Hitler is executed.

details.label: What you know
text: The other Centrists: there are 2 to 4 of you, and you open your eyes together at setup. You know nothing about anyone else.

details.label: Radicalisation
text: You hold a Liberal membership card, so the Communists can radicalise you. A radicalised Centrist joins the Communists and wins only if the Communists win. The other Centrists are not told, so they may keep trusting a player who no longer plays for them.

details.label: Danger
text: Fascists and Communists will claim to be Centrists. A claim proves nothing to the rest of the table, and only the real Centrists know who is lying.

details.label: How to play it
text: Wait before you reveal that you are Centrists: a known group is easy to target. Use your trust to form governments, and check your card after every Radicalisation.
